scope: Eleven published indoor rinks without an automatic public-skating schedule, plus indoor rinks with public skating absent from data/by-arenas-prod.csv and data/arena-cards.

class_legend.A: Machine-readable online schedule with dates (HTML table or text, JSON/API, or PDF). A parser is possible.
class_legend.B: Images or social posts only. Manual entry or OCR.
class_legend.C: Phone only, or no online session schedule.
class_legend.D: No public skating now: closed or off-season.

rinks.name: Спортивно-развлекательный центр
rinks.format: WordPress HTML. Dated paragraphs plus price tables.
rinks.update_frequency: Not stated. On 2026-10-06 the page held only the next two days. Older weeks are not kept in the HTML.
rinks.schedule_example: 10.10 at 14:15, 17:30, 19:15; 11.10 at 15:15, 17:00, 19:00. Year is not printed; on census day those dates are 10–11 October 2026. Session length 45 min.
rinks.prices: Child under 14: 7.00 BYN / 45 min; passes 4/8/12 visits 28/49/75 BYN. Adult: 8.00 BYN; passes 32/56/80 BYN. Skate rental is paid at the desk; the rental amount is not in this table.

parser.structure: Paragraphs immediately after the heading «Сеансы массового катания:», pattern «ДД.ММ. в ЧЧ:ММ, ЧЧ:ММ». Assign the year as the next such date that is not in the past. Session length is a separate sentence (45 minutes). Ignore the rink-hire table (231–399 BYN per hour).

rinks.notes: Telegram t.me/LedovijDVOREC preview on 2026-10-06 did not carry the ice grid. Latest text posts there were 2026-08-26 and 2026-09-07.
